# UNEP - UN Environment Programme

> UNEP is the global authority for environmental governance, climate action, nature conservation, and pollution control within the United Nations system.

UNEP serves as the leading voice on environmental issues across the UN, coordinating international environmental policy and sustainable development initiatives. The organization operates through regional offices and multilingual portals to engage member states and stakeholders worldwide.

## Key Topics

- UN Environment Programme
- Environmental Governance
- Climate Action
- Climate Change
- Sustainable Development Goals
- Biodiversity Conservation
- Chemicals and Pollution
- Environmental Policy
- Ecosystems
- UN Environment Assembly
- Regional Offices
- Committee of Permanent Representatives
- Waste Management
- Environmental Topics

## Core Portals & Language Access

- [UNEP Homepage](https://www.unep.org): UNEP homepage: global authority for environment, climate, nature, pollution
- [UNEP Arabic Portal](https://www.unep.org/ar): UNEP Arabic language portal for environmental governance and climate action
- [UNEP Spanish Portal](https://www.unep.org/es): UNEP Spanish language portal for environmental governance and sustainability
- [UNEP French Portal](https://www.unep.org/fr): UNEP French language portal for global environmental governance and climate
- [UNEP Portuguese Portal](https://www.unep.org/pt-br): UNEP Portuguese language portal for environmental governance and sustainability
- [UNEP Russian Portal](https://www.unep.org/ru): UNEP Russian language portal for climate change and sustainable development
- [UNEP Chinese Portal](https://www.unep.org/zh-hans): UNEP Chinese language portal for environmental governance and climate action

## Organizational Governance

- [Committee of Permanent Representatives](https://www.unep.org/cpr): CPR governance structure, accreditation, and member state representation
- [Evaluation Office](https://www.unep.org/evaluation-office): UNEP Evaluation Office: accountability, learning, and evidence-based decision-making
